bodyText:
Your species has been chosen by the Architect to join countless others on a path to power. As a member of the Collective, you will use nano to enhance your body, gain access to combat classifications, and harness power previously unknown.

Don't get caught up in the game-like system though. If your character dies, they're gone for good. Be careful and choose wisely, as even a small miscalculation in planning can lead to the end.
